# `facts`

Helper: `facts([label, value, { sub }], ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`Facts`, label left / value right rows) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCardLine` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Rows with label on the left (ink-soft) and value on the right (600, ink) with an optional small sub line; divider between rows.

## Variants

- With or without sub line

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

ink-soft, ink, line

## Do

- Use for key facts of one object (patient, invoice)

## Don't

- Do not use for 3+ comparable rows (table)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Value right aligned.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Key facts, dividers between rows
